4 ازجّ الرُّمْحَ ; (IAar, ISk, S, A, K;) and ↓ زجّجهُ ; (A, TA;) and ↓ زَجَّهُ , aor.
زَجُ3َ , inf. n. زَجٌّ; (Msb;) and زَجَّاهُ; (TA;) He put, or made, a زُجّ [q. v.] to the spear. (IAar, ISk, S, A, Msb, K.) ―
-b2- The first of these phrases is said also to signify He removed, or took off, its زُجّ from the spear: (A:) IAar is related to have said thus; but he is also related to have said that this signification is not allowable. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
